source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: At the original import revision, AccountHub.onServerLoaded calls getRefreshToken without await, tests the promise for truth and passes it as detail.token to fire.async. The event schema requires token to be a string, while the actual native getRefreshToken method is async and awaits login lookup. This is a static promise-versus-string mismatch at the real receiver/caller boundary. Accepted AccountHub source makes onServerLoaded async and awaits the token before the empty-token guard and event. The original comment about a token already being stored does not make lookup synchronous. No account-creation or event-validation failure was executed.
title: The original AccountHub listener forwards an unresolved refresh-token promise
